title: Laravel Read Replicas: Prevent Stale Reads After a Write
content:
Laravel's PreventStaleDatabaseReads middleware keeps a user's reads on the write database after they save, so read replica lag doesn't show them old data.

The post Laravel Read Replicas: Prevent Stale Reads After a Write appeared first on Laravel News.
